note: [LLM critic, medium conf] The AI sends a 240pt Custodian Guard unit on a 28% charge into the enemy deployment zone. The score is only 0.66 because large positive terms for damage and plan lock offset a strong chance penalty. Fix: Multiply the damage and plan-lock bonuses by the charge probability so they are expected values. Require a minimum charge probability, or a minimum score margin, before declaring a charge with a high-value unit. Add a cost for a failed charge that leaves the unit out of position, and for overwatch damage taken before the charge roll.
